statements.name: channels
statements.sql: SELECT id::bigint,name,tvg_id,tvc_guide_stationid,epg_data_id::bigint,auto_created,channel_group_id::bigint FROM dispatcharr_channels_channel WHERE ($1 AND epg_data_id IS NULL) OR (NOT $1 AND id=ANY($2)) LIMIT 65537

statements.name: single_exact
statements.sql: SELECT e.id::bigint FROM epg_epgdata e JOIN epg_epgsource s ON s.id=e.epg_source_id WHERE s.is_active AND UPPER(e.tvg_id::text)=UPPER($1) ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT 1

statements.name: catalog
statements.sql: SELECT e.id::bigint,e.name,e.tvg_id,e.epg_source_id::bigint,s.priority::bigint,s.source_type,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epg_programdata p WHERE p.epg_id=e.id) AS has_programs FROM epg_epgdata e JOIN epg_epgsource s ON s.id=e.epg_source_id WHERE s.is_active AND ($1::bigint IS NULL OR e.id=$1) LIMIT 65537

statements.name: settings
statements.sql: SELECT key,CASE WHEN octet_length(value::text)<=65536 THEN value ELSE NULL END AS value,COALESCE(octet_length(value::text),0)<=65536 AS supported FROM core_coresettings WHERE key IN ('preferred-region','epg_settings')

statements.name: bulk_candidates
statements.sql: SELECT c.id::bigint,x.epg FROM dispatcharr_channels_channel c JOIN jsonb_to_recordset($1) x(id bigint,epg bigint) ON x.id=c.id JOIN epg_epgdata e ON e.id=x.epg WHERE c.epg_data_id IS DISTINCT FROM x.epg

statements.name: bulk_update
statements.sql: UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel c SET epg_data_id=x.epg_data_id FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1) x(channel_id bigint,epg_data_id bigint) WHERE c.id=x.channel_id

statements.name: child_epgs
statements.sql: SELECT e.id::bigint,e.name,e.tvg_id,e.epg_source_id::bigint,s.source_type,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM epg_programdata p WHERE p.epg_id=e.id) AS has_programs FROM epg_epgdata e LEFT JOIN epg_epgsource s ON s.id=e.epg_source_id WHERE e.id=ANY($1)

statements.name: single_update
statements.sql: UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_channel SET epg_data_id=$2 WHERE id=$1

statements.name: mark_custom
statements.sql: INSERT INTO dispatcharr_channels_channelgroupm3uaccount(channel_group_id,m3u_account_id,custom_properties,enabled,auto_channel_sync,auto_sync_channel_start,auto_sync_channel_end,last_seen,is_stale) SELECT $1,id,'{}'::jsonb,true,false,NULL,NULL,now(),false FROM m3u_m3uaccount WHERE name='custom' AND locked ON CONFLICT(channel_group_id,m3u_account_id) DO NOTHING

statements.name: serialize
statements.sql: SELECT to_jsonb(c) AS raw,CASE WHEN o.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_jsonb(o) END AS ov,a.name AS account_name,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('raw',to_jsonb(s),'account_name',ma.name) ORDER BY cs."order") FROM dispatcharr_channels_channelstream cs JOIN dispatcharr_channels_stream s ON s.id=cs.stream_id LEFT JOIN m3u_m3uaccount ma ON ma.id=s.m3u_account_id WHERE cs.channel_id=c.id),'[]'::jsonb) AS streams FROM dispatcharr_channels_channel c LEFT JOIN dispatcharr_channels_channeloverride o ON o.channel_id=c.id LEFT JOIN m3u_m3uaccount a ON a.id=c.auto_created_by_id LEFT JOIN dispatcharr_channels_channelgroup g ON g.id=c.channel_group_id LEFT JOIN dispatcharr_channels_channelgroup og ON og.id=o.channel_group_id LEFT JOIN epg_epgdata e ON e.id=c.epg_data_id LEFT JOIN epg_epgdata oe ON oe.id=o.epg_data_id LEFT JOIN epg_epgsource es ON es.id=e.epg_source_id LEFT JOIN epg_epgsource oes ON oes.id=oe.epg_source_id WHERE true AND c.id=$1

statements.name: station_existing
statements.sql: SELECT tvg_id FROM epg_epgdata WHERE epg_source_id=$1

statements.name: station_insert
statements.sql: INSERT INTO epg_epgdata(tvg_id,name,icon_url,epg_source_id) SELECT x.sid,x.name,x.logo,$1 FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2) x(sid text,name text,logo text) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

statements.name: station_update
statements.sql: UPDATE epg_epgdata e SET name=x.name,icon_url=x.logo FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2) x(sid text,name text,logo text) WHERE e.epg_source_id=$1 AND e.tvg_id=x.sid AND (e.name IS DISTINCT FROM x.name OR e.icon_url IS DISTINCT FROM x.logo)
